Okay, so the Avatar sequels. Here's what we know so far.

All the sequels:

  • There will be three of them.
  • Each movie will have a self-contained story.
  • At least one will take place on Pandora.
  • Sam Worthington, Zoe Saldana, Stephen Lang, AND Sigourney Weaver have all confirmed they'll be returning as their characters from the first film.
  • Sigourney Weaver's character, Dr. Grace Augustine, will only be in flashbacks.
  • James Horner will be composing for all of the sequels.
  • They'll be shot back to back.
  • They will introduce "whole new worlds, habitats, and cultures."
  • All of the sequels will have different writers.
  • It is hinted that none of the sequels will have "Avatar" in the title, due to the ending of the first film.
  • Sam Worthington confirmed the three sequels started shooting in fall of 2014.
  • According to James Horner, James Cameron had written enough material for four sequels, which had to be whittled down to three. The rumors that there will be four sequels are still circulating, however, so who knows on this one.

Avatar 2:

  • Currently untitled, using the working title of "Avatar 2"
  • Screenwriters: James Cameron, Rick Jaffa, and Amanda Silver
  • Confirmed for IMAX release as well as regular format.
  • There will be a deeper exploration into the Na'vi culture.
  • There will be exploration into the Pandoran oceans, but the film will not exclusively take place in the ocean.
  • Sigourney Weaver has stated her scenes for the film would not be shot until fall 2015.
  • Giovanni Ribisi has hinted at a possible return of Parker Selfridge.
  • Dileep Rao has confirmed that humans will be the main antagonist.
  • James Cameron has confirmed that most characters would be returning.
  • Speculated release date: 2017 (though some sites are saying December 5th, 2017 or Christmas day 2017)

Avatar 3:

  • Currently untitled, using the working title of "Avatar 3"
  • Screenwriters: James Cameron and Josh Friedman
  • This film will explore more of the Alpha Centauri System, which Pandora is a part of.
  • Speculated release date: December 2018

Avatar 4:

  • Currently untitled, using the working title of "Avatar 4"
  • Screenwriters: James Cameron and Shane Salerno
  • Speculated to be the rumored Avatar prequel.
  • Speculated release date: TBA

Here are some extra bits I've found:

  • James Cameron: "In the second and third films, which will be self contained stories that also fulfill a greater story arc, we will not back off the throttle of Avatar's visual and emotional horsepower, and will continue to explore its themes and characters, which touched the hearts of audiences in all cultures around the world. I'm looking forward to returning to Pandora, a world where our imaginations can run wild."
  • Jon Landau: "I think you will definitely have humans in the sequel...there are going to be good humans, there are going to be bad humans...there are going to be good Na'vi, there are going to be bad Na'vi..."
  • Jon Landau on Avatar 2: "It's going to be like the Floating Mountains in the first movie. It's not going to be all underwater; it's going to be a place we go to, leave and come back to."
  • James Cameron on Avatar 2: "Basically, if you survived the first film, you get to be in the second film, at least in some form."

So...who wants to talk about the sequels?
